WorkspaceColourDto.description:
A workspace's colour: one slot of a fixed palette of eight, never held by
two workspaces (`workspace.colour.set`).

description: The colour the workspace now holds, and the workspace it swapped with.

changed.description: `false` when the workspace already held it: nothing is written.

swapped_with.description: The workspace that held the colour and now holds the old one.

title: WorkspaceColourSetResult
